title: Removed residual shadow routing from runtime
points: Valid Router plans now cross runtime without query-regex surface overrides; corrective retries enforce structural contracts only.
Empty-plan recovery recognizes only closed deterministic compute products and otherwise uses one generic scoped evidence fallback.
The Router now emits typed entity resolution metadata, replacing uppercase-word stoplists as the authority over company, unresolved, and topic mentions.
Report inventory and mixed-duration financial screens now activate through typed deterministic-surface fields rather than ask wording.
Narrative retrieval no longer appends bank-deposit pages through a topic-specific runtime booster; the searchable filing vocabulary owns those terms.
Focused runtime collision cases cover plan preservation, typed entity context, both deterministic surfaces, compute recovery, and deposit retrieval.
